prose: CNBC reports that Butterfly Effect, parent of AI agent startup Manus, raised more than $500 million, led by Boyu Capital and IDG Capital. It is the first funding round since Meta was forced to unwind its purchase of Manus.
Only the Techmeme excerpt was read, so valuation and investor details beyond the lead names are not available.
highlights: Led by Boyu Capital and IDG Capital
First round since Meta's buyout was unwound
